title: FootFlex Payment Policies & FAQs
content: FootFlex supports a comprehensive array of secure online and offline payment options powered by Razorpay Payment Gateway. Accepted payment channels include: 1) UPI Payment Apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, CRED), 2) Debit & Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Maestro, American Express), 3) Net Banking across 50+ leading Indian banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak, etc.), 4) Digital Wallets (Paytm, Mobikwik, Freecharge, Amazon Pay), 5) Cash on Delivery (COD) available for select pin codes with a verification OTP. All transactions on FootFlex use end-to-end 256-bit SSL encryption and comply strictly with PCI-DSS security standards. GST tax invoices are generated for every completed purchase.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted on FootFlex?
faqs.answer: FootFlex accepts Razorpay UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), Net Banking (50+ banks), Digital Wallets, and Cash on Delivery (COD).

faqs.question: Is paying on FootFlex safe and secure?
faqs.answer: Yes! All transactions on FootFlex are processed via Razorpay's PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateway with 256-bit SSL encryption. We never store your CVV or sensitive card PIN numbers.

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available on FootFlex?
faqs.answer: Yes, COD is available for eligible orders. An OTP verification code sent to your mobile phone is required to confirm COD orders.

faqs.question: Can I get a GST Tax Invoice for my business purchase on FootFlex?
faqs.answer: Yes, an official GST tax invoice is generated for every order and can be downloaded anytime from the 'My Orders' section.

faqs.question: What should I do if my payment gets declined during checkout?
faqs.answer: Ensure your card/bank has enabled online transactions and international/domestic limits. If the issue persists, retry using UPI or Net Banking.
